Told Apart

Can the reader this theme is named for tell these two colours apart? Fourteen themes, nineteen graded semantic oppositions, four readings each. Every verdict on every screen is a WORD: this app's own audit found no theme in its subject that survives all three readers, so nothing here is carried by colour.

This app wears light-colorblind-high-contrast and dark-colorblind-high-contrast — the pair its own audit recommends on its own criterion: fewest readings below the floor across the three simulations, summed over the two grounds.

What a pronto identity can hold

This platform's design layer holds one identity in two appearances, and the two are closed twins. Pairing a light-ground theme against a dark-ground one by reader and contrast gives the pairs below; the themes after them have no light half at all, and none is invented for them.
